arxiv-1807-02838.title: Ground state of a bosonic massive charged particle in the presence of external fields in a Gödel-type spacetime Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-1807-02838.creator: Edilberto O. Silva e1
arxiv-1807-02838.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Edilberto O. Silva e1. The relativistic quantum dynamics of a spinless charged particle interacting with both Aharonov-Bohm and Coulomb-type potentials in the Gödel-type spacetime is considered. The dynamics of the system is governed by the Klein-Gordon equation with interactions. We verify that it is possible to establish a quantum condition between the energy of the particle and the parameter that characterizes the vorticist of the spacetime. We rigorously analyze the ground state of the system and determine the corresponding wavefunctions to it.

arxiv-2304-08110.title: Universal platform of point-gap topological phases from topological materials
arxiv-2304-08110.creator: Daichi Nakamura, Kazuya Inaka, Nobuyuki Okuma, Masatoshi Sato
arxiv-2304-08110.description: Abstract Whereas point-gap topological phases are responsible for exceptional phenomena intrinsic to non-Hermitian systems, their realization in quantum materials is still elusive. Here we propose a simple and universal platform of point-gap topological phases constructed from Hermitian topological insulators and superconductors.

arxiv-2306-03225.title: Skein (3+1)-TQFTs from non-semisimple ribbon categories.
arxiv-2306-03225.creator: Francesco Costantino, Nathan Geer, Benjamin Haïoun, Bertrand Patureau-Mirand
arxiv-2306-03225.description: Abstract . Using skein theory very much in the spirit of the Reshetikhin–Turaev constructions, we define a ( 3 + 1 ) (3+1) -TQFT associated with possibly non-semisimple finite unimodular ribbon tensor categories. State spaces are given by admissible skein modules, and we prescribe the TQFT on handle attachments.

arxiv-2412-02796.title: Harnessing Multiple Correlated Networks for Exact Community Recovery
arxiv-2412-02796.creator: Miklós Z. Rácz, Jifan Zhang
arxiv-2412-02796.description: Abstract We study the problem of learning latent community structure from multiple correlated networks, focusing on edge-correlated stochastic block models with two balanced communities. Recent work of Gaudio, Rácz, and Sridhar (COLT 2022) determined the precise information-theoretic threshold for exact community recovery using two correlated graphs; in particular, this showcased the subtle interplay between community recovery and graph matching.

arxiv-2412-07063.title: Residual finiteness of A 2 , 3 , 2 ​ n A_{2,3,2n} triangle Artin groups
arxiv-2412-07063.creator: Greyson Meyer
arxiv-2412-07063.description: Abstract . We prove that triangle Artin groups of the type A 2 , 3 , 2 ​ n A_{2,3,2n} are residually finite for all n > 3 n>3 . This requires splitting these triangle Artin groups as graphs of groups and then proving that each of these graphs of groups has finite stature with respect to its vertex groups.

arxiv-2505-22935.title: Is Noise Conditioning Necessary? A Unified Theory of Unconditional Graph Diffusion Models
arxiv-2505-22935.creator: Jipeng Li, Yanning Shen
arxiv-2505-22935.description: Abstract Explicit noise-level conditioning is widely regarded as essential for the effective operation of Graph Diffusion Models (GDMs). In this work, we challenge this assumption by investigating whether denoisers can implicitly infer noise levels directly from corrupted graph structures, potentially eliminating the need for explicit noise conditioning.

arxiv-2509-09554.title: Fast Polarisation-Aware Decoder for Non-Binary Polar Codes
arxiv-2509-09554.creator: Joseph Jabour, Ali Chamas Al-Ghouwayel, Emmanuel Boutillon
arxiv-2509-09554.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joseph Jabour, Ali Chamas Al-Ghouwayel, Emmanuel Boutillon. The paper explores the emerging field of low-complexity non-binary (NB) polar decoders. It demonstrates that customising each kernel of a NB polar code (PC) through an offline analysis can lead to a significant reduction in the decoder’s complexity. The proposed decoder, termed the fast successive cancellation polarisation-aware (FSC-PA) , achieves this by determining the minimum computational load of the parity check nodes that share the same level of input polarisation.

pmc-11366823.creator: Sommer Knight, Xin Qiang Yang, G. Eric Jarvis
pmc-11366823.description: IntroductionThe mental health disparities suffered by the English-speaking Afro-Caribbean diaspora living with psychosis in North America and the United Kingdom have been well described for decades, but the root causes of these disparities remain poorly understood. pmc-12576148.title: Screw Angulation and Insertion Sequence Increase Interfragmentary Compression When Using Plates for Midfoot Arthrodesis: Foam-Surrogate and Cadaveric Validation
pmc-12576148.creator: James Johnson, Leah Buch, Shannon King, Mia Knauf, Joshua Kim, Christopher Gross, Daniel Scott, Samuel Adams, Kenneth Dupont, David Safranski
pmc-12576148.description: Background:Achieving interfragmentary compression and stability is critical for successful bone healing in fracture fixation and arthrodesis procedures. Modern orthopaedic plating systems incorporating variable-angle screw designs offer greater versatility; however, the impact of screw trajectory on interfragmentary compression and contact area has not been adequately explored.

pmc-12731217.title: A Perspective on Bio-Inspired Approaches as Sustainable Proxy Towards an Accelerated Net Zero Emission Energy Transition
pmc-12731217.creator: Miguel Chen Austin, Katherine Chung-Camargo
pmc-12731217.description: The global energy transition faces a chasm between current policy commitments (IEA’s STEPS) and the deep, rapid transformation required to realize all national net zero pledges (IEA’s APC). This perspective addresses the critical innovation and policy gap blocking the APC pathway, where many high-impact, clean technologies remain at low-to-medium Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs 3–6) and lack formal policy support.
